newsitem.title: UK: UK stocks end sharply lower as rate fears hit Dow.
newsitem.headline: UK stocks end sharply lower as rate fears hit Dow.

text.p: Britain's FTSE 100 index suffered its biggest one-day fall in points of the year so far on Thursday as Wall Street dropped on renewed fears of an imminent rise in U.S. interest rates.

Markets in Europe and the U.S., already weighed down by fears of tighter credit, took fright in early afternoon as comments from the head of the U.S. central bank were taken as a signal of a rate hike as early as next week.
The FTSE 100 index closed 74.1 points lower at 4,258.1, its biggest loss since an 88-point tumble last December -- also prompted by comments from Federal Reserve chief Alan Greenspan.
